name: DCA Señor Buzz Churros (Pixar Pier) Cinnamon Sugar Galaxy Churro (Avoid Spicy "Caliente" Churro!)
brandOrRestaurant: Señor Buzz Churros (Pixar Pier · Disney California Adventure)
